title.zh: 飞鼠的 DSH 插件索引

description.zh: 个人维护的 DeepSeek Harness 插件集合。把本索引的 URL 添加到 DSH 的插件市场后，这里的插件会出现在插件页，发新版时会显示更新提示。
description.en: A personally maintained collection of DeepSeek Harness plugins. Add this index URL in the DSH plugin market and listed plugins appear on the plugins page with update hints on new releases.

description.zh: 让 Codex 通过 MCP 把任务委托给 DSH 子代理执行，DSH 侧边栏面板实时显示运行状态；支持在 DSH 设置里选择子代理模型，DSH 重启后自动同步 Codex 端点。
description.en: Let Codex delegate tasks to DSH subagents over MCP with a live DSH sidebar panel; pick the subagent model in DSH settings and the Codex endpoint syncs automatically after DSH restarts.
